answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital in a secure vault. To gain network influence, an entity must commit an umber of tokens proportional to their intended voting power, effectively turning the cost of identity into a market-based expenditure. A malicious actor attempting to spawn a comet of fake nodes faces prohibitive capital costs, as each partition dilutes their cumulative influence while requiring locked liquidity, ultimately making subversion an economic loss.
